_comment: Curated both-axes facts for LEDGER.md. Documents only. Append/edit the narrative facts here; the per-edit trail is auto-appended from VERSION_LEDGER.jsonl by scripts/build_ledger.py (invoked by the every-edit hook).

incidents.note: web UX shipped 3 data-captioned decorative surfaces — (1) Output Tape waveform = Math.sin buildWave() under 'settled render'; (2) Lane Console hardcoded 62/74/33/55 with inert sliders under 'tolerances & weights'; (3) 'drift' meter = role-spread proxy (max-min)*1.4 captioned as the holonomy/drift quantity. Tape is a REPEAT of the previously-remediated sine-art scar. Remediation (REAL-OR-ABSENT, per surface): (1) buildWave removed, tape shows honest-empty 'waveform not wired', 'settled render' clause stripped (playhead/clock stay real); (2) lanes wired to real per-bar Layer-0 phi statistics (region/continuity/novelty/density) via read-only telemetry reductions, inert sliders removed, 'tolerances & weights' caption dropped; (3) the proxy replaced by the engine's real gauge-drift split — loop[g] wired live from committed occupancy (ets.meters.gauge_loop, incorruptible holonomy), slide[g] honestly DISARMED because the v0 world's gauge frame is frozen-identity (documented engine construction wall, surfaced not patched). Standing caption guard added: cloud/tests/test_web_fab_guard.py (WEB-FAB-1 caption->data-source map + WEB-FAB-2 no-procedural-art-under-data-caption; both proven to bite). Core ets/ + architecture-v6/ets/ ZERO-DIFF (every engine quantity READ via the bridge). Prereg: cloud/PREREG-webfab-remediation.md. Rollback tag: pre-webfab-remediation-2026-07-18 @ b054411.

commit f0db9d3 ('TRACKS: restore the cell steering component the click used to send') shipped an unregistered A/B onto Amendment 2's columns-only fieldScrubLeans(mag, w): changed the signature to fieldScrubLeans(tid, mag, w) and emitted BOTH ['role', tid, r] (CELL, casting/pick lane) and ['col', r] (COLUMN, settlement lane) from a single click, putting a second writer on the (track,role) cell lane WS-9/WS-10 (papers/PREREG-waveform-scrub.md) give exactly one owner (the GRID cell gesture). The commit's own diagnosis was correct and disclosed in its message — 'a settlement column lean is soft by construction and does nothing at all on a region-disarmed corpus' — but instead of surfacing that wall (per the standing walls-are-surfaced-not-patched rule) it silently routed around it by bolting on the stronger CELL channel. It also stacked a new comment ('RESTORED CELL COMPONENT...') directly beneath the original 'TRACK ID IS NOT AN ARGUMENT — this function structurally cannot write a per-track lean' comment without removing the now-false original, leaving both present and contradictory. REVERTED per operator ruling 2026-08-14: fieldScrubLeans back to the 2-argument columns-only form (matching origin/main byte-for-byte in that region), the 'RESTORED CELL COMPONENT' comment removed, the original 'TRACK ID IS NOT AN ARGUMENT' comment intact and now true again. Verified: cloud/tests/test_waveform_scrub_fe.py went from 9 failed/36 passed (HEAD, with the hunk) to 45 passed/0 failed (after revert). fieldRoleStripMarks (D-1 strip's 'YOUR LEAN' readout) was re-checked against the MISLABEL rule: it already sources force from st.bias[['col',r]] only, which under-reported while the click also wrote a cell entry; after the revert the click writes col only, so the readout is exact again — no separate code change needed there. The wall itself is written up with numbers (not just recalled from the commit message) at papers/FINDING-column-lean-region-disarmed-corpus.md: on demo.etsworld under a region-disarmed sigma clone (the same technique cloud/tools/track_role_grid_verify.py's ratified gate already uses), COLUMN's pushed value is bit-identical to its own baseline to 15 decimal places (0.536458333333333...) while CELL moves two orders of magnitude (0.000326 damped / 0.150798 base / 0.479248 amplified) under the identical disarmed sigma.

engine_edit_disclosures.note: Two edits to architecture-v6/ets/writer/ landed on 2026-08-14 with no accompanying prereg/REGISTRY/LEDGER entry, though every cloud/-tree edit made that same day (across the parallel worktrees active that day) DOES appear in VERSION_LEDGER.jsonl's per-edit trail — neither architecture-v6/ets/writer/clamp.py nor realize.py shows an entry there for either edit. (1) commit 7e7b8af (13:34:33Z), 'LIVE: pin each slot to its own moment of the passage': ClampTerms gains slot_pin (a new field), and realize.py::_admits gains a THIRD comparison clause (after the track_mask/openness test and the unit_pin test), threaded through _choose/_choose_original/_choose_fast/place_slot. Fixes a measured self-mixing bug (one bar drew tatums 0, 8, 15, 16, 23 at once). This edit is a third comparison where papers/PREREG-live-mode.md §2.1 registers ClampTerms's restriction as ONE comparison and calls _admits 'the only engine logic ClampTerms adds' — both now false. Documented retroactively at papers/PREREG-live-mode.md#slot_pin--undisclosed-engine-edit-retroactive-disclosure-2026-08-14 and REGISTRY.jsonl id live-mode-slot-pin-undisclosed-2026-08-14, kind engine-edit-pending-ratification. STATUS: AWAITING OPERATOR RATIFICATION, not ratified as of this writing (2026-08-14). Byte-identity proven when slot_pin is absent (hash 22d27d511b433c86... unchanged with the clause present-but-unused vs. physically removed, across 16 bars / 4 fence configurations); this proves the neutral law, not that the comparison set is unchanged when slot_pin is supplied, which it now is on every LIVE straight-play bar. (2) commit 41fa549 (15:35:27Z), 'Close the two unfenced-cast holes: a fenced passage stays on its own tracks': fences the degenerate early-return branch in both choosers so no cast escapes ClampTerms via that path. Flagged inline at papers/PREREG-live-mode.md §BS.1(a) as 'ENGINE-FILE EDIT, FLAGGED FOR RATIFICATION' at the time it landed, and IS ratified. Standing rule issued after the slot_pin gap surfaced: any change to a carrier's TYPE, or to the comparison set of _admits, is an engine edit requiring prereg + REGISTRY + ratification REGARDLESS OF NEUTRALITY — one silent edit of this shape makes every 'no engine changes' claim in the project unverifiable by inspection. NOTE: this LEDGER_DATA.json key is not yet rendered into LEDGER.md by scripts/build_ledger.py (a code change, out of scope for the DOCS-ONLY pass that added this entry); the matching prose below the Incidents section was added to LEDGER.md by hand and will need to be re-added, or the generator extended, if LEDGER.md is regenerated from this data file before the generator is updated.
